items.summary_en: The author found that the web version of Codex actually runs the full 5.6 sol model, while local sessions were silently routed to luna — causing false 'login expired' errors on private repos and a half-hour fight with a nonexistent bug. It shows the UI can claim one model while the backend serves another, so AI coding users should verify which model is actually handling their requests.

The approach uses a PDCA cycle as the backbone, supported by seven-stage guardrails, TPRD, a three-layer knowledge system, and a Highway + ATV hybrid Agent architecture, while covering test validation and effect review. Teams integrating AI into complex legacy systems will find the guardrails and acceptance design especially relevant.

items.summary_zh: 智能体适应度函数是一种架构治理检查：由经过校准的 AI 智能体按明确评分标准评估限定范围的证据包，返回含证据、置信度与理由的结构化判定，但不替代编译器、SLO 等确定性门控。它把架构意图转化为可重复、可审计的判断，适用于人工审查无法覆盖的 PR、契约变更和智能体生成补丁等场景。
items.summary_en: Agentic fitness functions are an architecture-governance check performed by calibrated AI agents: they score a scoped evidence pack against explicit rubrics and return structured verdicts with evidence, confidence, and rationale. They sit alongside deterministic gates like compilers and SLO checks rather than replacing them. This makes judgment-heavy reviews repeatable and auditable for channels where human review can't scale, such as every PR, contract change, or agent-generated patch.
